# viettelcloud_fs_filesystem (Data Source)

Get one Viettel Cloud File Storage filesystem by ID or exact filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a filesystem by ID.
data "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
}

# Look up a filesystem by name and zone.
data "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem" "by_name" {
  name = "example-filesystem"
  zone = "zone-a"
}

# Look up a filesystem by subnet.
data "viettelcloud_fs_filesystem" "by_subnet" {
  subnet_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Filesystem ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Filesystem name to filter by.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID (UUID) to filter by.
- `zone` (String) Zone name to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the filesystem was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Filesystem description.
- `filesystem_type_id` (String) Filesystem type ID (UUID).
- `filesystem_type_name` (String) Filesystem type name.
- `has_snapshot` (Boolean) Whether the filesystem has at least one snapshot.
- `migration_percentage` (Number) Migration progress percentage. Null when not migrating.
- `mount_target_address` (String) Mount target IP address.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID).
- `protocol` (String) Filesystem protocol (NFS or SMB).
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `region_name` (String) Region name.
- `size` (Number) Filesystem size in GiB.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Source snapshot ID (UUID) that the filesystem was created from. Null when it was not created from a snapshot.
- `snapshot_policy` (Attributes) Applied snapshot policy. Null when no policy is applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot_policy))
- `status` (String) Current filesystem status.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the subnet.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the filesystem was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID (UUID) of the subnet.
- `vpc_name` (String) VPC name of the subnet.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID).

### Nested Schema for `snapshot_policy`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Policy ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Policy name.
